paras: Application: Nissan 350Z, 370Z, Skyline V35/V36 and Infiniti G35/G37 – VQ35DE, VQ35HR and VQ37VHR engines Part Type: Upgrade fuel rails (pair) Part Number: 20-0458

The Radium Engineering VQ fuel rails are a high-flow upgrade for Nissan and Infiniti VQ35DE, VQ35HR and VQ37VHR V6 engines. Machined from 6061 aluminium and black anodised, each rail features a large internal bore and is compatible with all common fuel types including E85.
hl: Billet Construction: Machined 6061 aluminium, black anodised
Large Internal Bore: Supports high-power fuel requirements
8AN ORB Ports: Four per rail – two end ports and two bottom ports
14mm Injector Bores: Suits OEM injectors and aftermarket injectors with OEM VQ fitment
Flexible Plumbing: Run in parallel, in series or as a return-style system
Stainless Mounting: Stainless steel brackets and hardware; OEM injector clips reused on VQ35DE/VQ35HR
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Rail Kit for Nissan 350Z/370Z/Skyline V35/V36/Infiniti G35/G37 VQ35/37
